title: copyfile with system calls
summary: open/read/write/close a file; handle errors with errno.
hints: Read in a loop until read() returns 0; write exactly as many bytes as read() returned.
open(dst, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644) creates or empties the destination.
On failure, print strerror(errno) to stderr and return 1.
info: open returns a descriptor or -1; read(fd, buf, n) returns the bytes read (0 at EOF, -1 on error); write(fd, buf, n) returns the bytes written; close(fd). Errors set errno; strerror(errno) gives text. Headers: <fcntl.h> <unistd.h> <errno.h> <string.h>.
